observations.humor_and_timing: Rank inspection turns into permission to bring a pillow; Buddy holds his nose near untouched modaks while claiming moderation, so the picture prolongs the pause before Backwards. Study group turns the spiritual exam into a practical shelter behind Neet, whose two-ear reaction quietly undercuts his command posture. Quiet prayer makes Buddy choose restraint rather than making the devotional passage a noisy gag.
observations.voices_and_agency: Neet remains earnest and procedural, with a small visible nervousness. Buddy actively pursues food, safety, acceptance of his gift and continued company; his final pillow move is his own answer to departure. Ganesha remains warm and patient; the humans appropriately remain background presences in private counsel.
observations.cause_effect_and_pacing: Food permission produces a held lean and measured retreat; closet click produces the study-group move; reassurance about imperfect offerings nearly prompts a howl but Neet prevents waking the humans. Daylight and night transitions are explicit. The quieter farewell has room after three distinct illustrated moments.
observations.emotional_religious_payoff: The fantasy treats devotion affectionately. Joy and acceptance progress into the lesson of departure and continued family presence. The final Approved gently recalls Not approved, then Buddy moves his pillow nearer while farewell is still future. Leaving this last passage unillustrated protects its quiet emotional landing.
exact_image_states: Modaks: Buddy stands leaning toward an intact plate, muzzle short of food; seated Neet watches. This is the held temptation before backwards retreat, not eating or post-retreat.
Study: afternoon light, closed closet, Buddy behind Neet, both alert; no vacuum reveal. This is the completed retreat after Study group and the ear turn.

Counsel: both dogs look upward at the shrine; Buddy rests on his pillow and the red/yellow squeaky offering remains beside Ganesha. The accepted-gift moment precedes Buddy drawing breath and the quiet-prayer exchange.
observations.complementarity: Appetite-driven forward movement, nervous daylight formation and tranquil midnight listening have distinct poses, lighting, objects and emotional functions. The two shrine images serve different beats rather than repeating a portrait.
observations.material_findings_closure: Independent visual review accepts all three exact pinned image bytes and closes Buddy internal coat findings in modaks/study v004 after whole-image native reinspection.
